$comment: Shared project settings for this fork. In a trusted checkout (a claude.ai cloud session included) Claude Code registers this repository as the claude-seo marketplace, enables the plugin, and the SessionStart hook prepares the Python runtime and Chromium. CLAUDE_SEO_TRUST_PROXY lets url_safety work behind the cloud sandbox's loopback CONNECT proxy; it has no effect when no proxy is configured. See SECURITY.md.
